yoast.meta_description: LED & illuminated business signs in Jacksonville & NE Florida — lit channel letters, cabinet signs & monuments, built and installed by Brand 9 Signs.

faqs: How much does an LED business sign cost in Jacksonville?
Illuminated signs typically run $3,000–$20,000+ installed depending on whether it's lit letters, a cabinet, or a monument, plus size, lighting method, and permitting.
Is LED better than neon for signs?
For most businesses, yes — LED is brighter, more even, far more energy-efficient, and longer-lasting, with fewer service calls than neon or fluorescent.
Do you handle the electrical for lighted signs?
Yes. We spec the LED system and power supply and handle the sign's electrical and installation with our own crew as part of the project.
